reports.headline: Missing Residents Traced to the Old Mine
reports.body: The tracks of the missing lead from the theater to the old mine {dir} of the village {dist}. {name} went down with a lantern and came back without it, saying the people down there were alive, and that they had been made into something long and soft that moved through the walls.

reports.headline: What Is Being Kept in the Mine
reports.body: Miners refuse the old workings {dir} of here {dist}. {name} heard someone {they} knew calling for help from deep inside, and something answering in the same voice.
